change_boundary: Clarify the distinction between truthful diagnostic omission and a material factual error. Reconcile two now-development-only expected labels under already declared proposition-slot and completeness-assertion rules. Do not alter schema, rubrics, thresholds, isolation, retry policy, or study data.
development_rule: Run each of the 28 exposed development cases once at medium reasoning. Every existing gate must pass. No low/high search and no retry of a usable unfavorable judgment.
heldout_rule: Do not execute any QN case unless v4 development passes every unchanged gate and the exact prompt, suite, schema, rubrics, caller, effort, and thresholds are committed in a new freeze record first. Then run exactly two isolated passes.
failure_rule: Retain failure and prohibit study scoring if development or either heldout pass misses any gate. Do not relax thresholds or alter fresh heldout expectations after execution.
